title: Oven Roasted Canadian Baby Aubergine Gratin
description: A romantic Canadian dish featuring baby aubergine, slow-cooked to perfection with a citrusy and glassy-jelly texture, perfect for a low-glycemic diet
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the baby aubergine with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, mix the shredded grana padano cheese with a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of sliced onion.
Add a layer of the coated baby aubergine on top of the onion.
Sprinkle a third of the cheese mixture over the aubergine.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the aubergine is tender.
